explanation: i++ increments i but evaluates to the value i had BEFORE the increment, so result gets 5 while i becomes 6. ++i would evaluate to the new value and print 6 6. Both forms leave i at 6 - the difference is only what the expression itself hands back.
hints: Both forms change i the same way. The question is what the expression gives back.
The ++ is after the variable. Does the expression use the old value or the new one?
